summary: Frontend-only test of Free World (/world) after the session TDZ fix + WorldClientGame timer redesign, as player1 at 1920 and 390. CRASH FIXED: opening levels 31/32 (GC4 L1/L2) shows the instructions overlay, no 'Cannot access session before initialization' and no pageerrors in any run. All options are still there: game name, time limit, game info, free attempts, info box, Sound toggle, SKIP DEMO / PLAY DEMO, Close (X) closes the overlay, START DEMO in the number-sequence demo, REPLAY DEMO / START ATTEMPT, countdown with EXIT, EXIT GAME during the official attempt, and a result screen showing SUCCESS, quote, time taken, correct 20/20, best time, free left, 'attempt used 1 of 3', CONTINUE and RETURN TO WORLD. Number Sequence demo + official run fully worked end to end on real data (4.262s success, attempts went from 3 to 2 free left). The countdown timer counts down in both demo and official; the official caption is 'OFFICIAL ATTEMPT - COUNTS AS ATTEMPT'. No level in the preview DB uses a WorldClientGame game, so I tested it by rewriting the API response in the browser (page.route on /api/world/level/N and /api/world/session/start, with the service worker unregistered; no DB change). Math Sprint and Reaction Time render the big .fwv3-timer with Clock3. world-client-practice-stopwatch shows 'PRACTICE MODE - NO ATTEMPT USED' and world-client-stopwatch shows 'OFFICIAL ATTEMPT - COUNTS AS ATTEMPT'. The official timer counts down (52.8 -> 51.3), Skip practice works and goes to the 'Ready to play?' screen. BUG: the practice timer in a WorldClientGame demo is frozen at the full time limit (00:55.000 does not tick). Champion: I forced champion.unlocked=true in the browser and fired 'pl-world-champion-select'. The ChampionStage intro (Grand Championship / Enter the Arena) renders. Instructions show NO LIMIT / STOPWATCH, 6 colours / 20 questions and 3 attempts. The Colour Match demo works (practice 1/5, SKIP DEMO), and the Ready screen shows CHAMPION MODE - FASTEST WINS. START ATTEMPT gets 403 CHAMPION_NOT_READY from the server, shown as an inline error. So the champion official stopwatch, the result submission and the finale could not be run in preview. The champion leaderboard view (lb-champ-select) loads and is empty. The LEVEL BOARDS nav button is visible and works: the HybridLevelBoards modal shows GC4 tabs L9 and L10, game/status, your best/rank, #1-#5 Bonus Token rewards, the provisional note and L9 rows (#1 GameZoo Admin 00:17.12). The L10 tab shows 'No successful times yet' and Close works. EveryLevelWorld is NOT reachable in preview (config details under context_for_next_testing_agent).

ui_bugs.issue: The practice timer never moves. It stays at the full limit (e.g. 00:55.000) for the whole demo. Cause: the demo timer useEffect (~line 577) only runs when demoStarted===true. setDemoStarted(true) is only called by the number-sequence START DEMO button (~line 2039). WorldClientGame demos have no start button, so demoStarted stays false (startDemo sets it false at ~line 514). Fix: set demoStarted=true when stage==='demo' && isWorldClientGame(level.game_id), or start the timer in that branch.

Regression: the title now shows the raw id 'COLOUR_MATCH'; it used to be 'COLOUR MATCH'. gameName = GAME_CATALOG label || gameId, and the catalog has no 'colour_match' entry. Non-champion colour_match results will also read 'You completed colour_match.' / 'colour_match was not completed.' because gameExperienceFor('colour_match') returns nothing (code inspection). Add a name fallback, e.g. isColour ? 'Colour Match'.
className 'fwv3-secondary' is not defined in freeWorldGameV3.css, so 'Skip practice' shows as plain unstyled text. It does not match the SKIP DEMO button style.

integration_issues.issue: Could not be tested in preview. POST /api/world/champion/session/start returns 403 CHAMPION_NOT_READY for player1: the levels are not completed and the champion window opens 2026-11-01. The champion stopwatch, the ChampionStage countdown frame/finale and leaderboard submission are unverified at runtime.

issues: The guide text appears twice: the game-specific-instructions box and the fwv3-info-box below it show the same objective/controls/timer text
The Gamepad2 banner icon is small and sits off-centre next to the title
REPLAY DEMO / START ATTEMPT labels wrap onto 2 lines in a narrow card (this was there before the change)
The support-assistant FAB overlaps the right edge of the game board during play

action_items: Start the demo timer for WorldClientGame demos (setDemoStarted(true) when entering demo for isWorldClientGame) so the practice clock ticks like the number-sequence demo
Restore the 'COLOUR MATCH' display name (fallback for 'colour_match' in gameName) on the instructions title and result copy
Style the 'Skip practice' button (define .fwv3-secondary or reuse the existing SKIP DEMO button class)
Optional: remove the duplicated guide text on WorldClientGame instructions; move the support FAB away from the game area while playing
critical_code_review_comments: FreeWorldNumberSequenceV3.jsx is ~3035 lines; it should be split (stages: instructions/demo/colour/official/result)
Moving gameId/gameName/gameGuide below the session useState fixes the TDZ crash; verified at runtime
The official WorldClientGame has no exit/abandon button. The number-sequence official has EXIT GAME, so this flow is not the same as the others
WorldClientGame submits taps: [] with a client-side solved flag. Server validation for non-number_sequence games should be checked by the main agent (not tested)

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (core flows pass; 1 HIGH timer bug, 1 MEDIUM naming regression, champion official not runnable in preview)

seed_data_creation: None. Side effects on player1 in the local test_database: GC4 L1 (map level 31) completed with 4.262s; GC4 L2 (map level 32) used 1 free attempt (an abandoned official session, now 2 free left).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login player1, go to /world, click data-testid free-world-level-32 (current GC4 level 2, number_sequence). To test WorldClientGame without DB changes: add_init_script to stub navigator.serviceWorker.register, unregister existing service workers and reload (a PWA service worker otherwise bypasses page.route). Then page.route the /api/world/level/N response to set level.game_id='math_sprint' and the /api/world/session/start response to set game_id. Champion: route /api/world/state to set champion.unlocked=true, then window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pl-world-champion-select',{detail:{championshipNumber:4}})); the server still rejects the official start with CHAMPION_NOT_READY. EveryLevelWorld is NOT reachable in preview. The only world_gc_competition_configs doc is gc_number 4, model 'every_level', activation_status 'active', engine 'legacy_hybrid'. /api/world/gc/active-model excludes engine 'legacy_hybrid', so it returns active:false (model champion_only, gc 4). To show EveryLevelWorld you would need an active config for the current GC (4) with model 'every_level' and an engine other than 'legacy_hybrid'. I did not change anything, per instructions. GC4 hybrid level boards are enabled only for L9 (colour_match, Open 30-31 Oct) and L10 (color_match, Upcoming).
